comments.note: branch-orchestrator.ts: The JSDoc for switchBranches() notes that errors surface only when workspaceManager.update() is called — this was accurate when update() was unconditional, but is now slightly misleading since update() is conditional. The JSDoc @throws clause could be clarified further to note that if all operations fail the update is skipped entirely and no error is thrown for missing project/workspace.

branch-orchestrator.test.ts (line ~319): The old test 'switchBranches updates DateModified even when some repos fail' was named 'some repos fail' but actually exercised a total-failure scenario (only a nonexistent repo). The test name was misleading; the rename in this WP corrects this, but it illustrates a pattern of test names not precisely matching the scenario exercised.
